description: Full-text search across FRED's 800,000+ economic series. Returns matching series IDs and titles ranked by popularity. Use when you don't know the exact series ID.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50 for observations, 25 for catalog queries).

search_text.description: Free-text search query (e.g. 'unemployment Texas', 'natural gas price', 'corporate profit').

name: fred_search
